name: Student Board of Directors
org: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
what_you_do: Learn what the Fed does. Work with other members to make a talk about the Fed for your school. Get career-planning advice from Fed leaders.
who_can_apply: Rising high school seniors at a public or private high school in the St. Louis area, in good academic standing. Children of St. Louis Fed employees cannot apply. Only one student per school is picked.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application season is closed. No date for the next one is posted.
how_to_apply: A teacher nominates you. You send the application form. Your teacher then sends a Teacher Recommendation form.
notes: After the program, members may apply for a limited number of summer internships at the St. Louis Fed. Questions: STLSSBoD@stls.frb.org.
